rationale: The stock gapped down ~6% on an earnings miss and is now consolidating in the lower quarter of today's range near $18.43, with the 9-EMA flat and price drifting sideways on declining 1-minute volume — no clear directional momentum to trade against. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.50%, VIXY +8.64%), which adds macro headwind, but the post-earnings selling appears to have stabilized without a clean continuation or reversal setup. With price pinned between VWAP resistance above ($18.59) and the session low below ($18.15), the risk/reward for either direction is unclear and the mechanical edge is insufficient to justify a position.
